scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us in a shared espresso setup: convenience, quality, cost, or ease of cleaning?

options.name: Breville Barista Express Espresso Machine
options.upside: Built-in grinder and consistent espresso quality
options.tradeoff: Requires regular cleaning and some learning curve
options.concern: Might be too complex for casual users

options.name: Nespresso Vertuo Plus Coffee and Espresso Maker
options.upside: Very quick and easy to use with minimal cleanup
options.tradeoff: Uses proprietary pods which add ongoing cost
options.concern: Limited control over espresso strength and flavor

options.name: Rancilio Silvia Semi-Automatic Espresso Machine
options.tradeoff: Requires skill and time to operate and clean
options.concern: Not beginner-friendly and slower prep time

options.name: AeroPress Coffee and Espresso Maker Kit
options.upside: Very affordable, portable, and easy to clean
options.tradeoff: Longer brew time and requires manual effort
options.concern: Less traditional espresso texture and volume
